verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM SaaS with public REST APIs, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence only states that RESTful APIs exist and offer integration support. Nothing in the pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
